data.name: A Rip In Time
data.detailed_description:
A World to Get Lost In. An Adventure to Share.

A Rip In Time is a massive 2D pixel-art fantasy RPG inspired by the classic adventures that made so many of us fall in love with gaming.

I've always loved getting completely lost in an RPG. Discovering somewhere new, finding that next piece of equipment, getting sidetracked for hours, or laughing with friends when everything goes wrong.

I've spent years trying to capture those feelings in a world that feels familiar, but offers something of its own.

Your Adventure, Your Way

Explore a sprawling fantasy world filled with quests, dungeons, professions, dangerous creatures, and secrets waiting to be discovered.

Experience responsive real-time combat, develop your character, discover new equipment, and forge your own path.

Whether you prefer adventuring alone, sharing the couch through local split-screen co-op, or exploring online with friends, there's no single right way to play.

Made for the Way You Play

I wanted A Rip In Time to feel just as comfortable on the couch as it does at a desk.

A lot of care has gone into performance, controller support, and the experience on Steam Deck, while also designing with Steam Machine and living-room play in mind.

After all, a big RPG adventure shouldn't have to be tied to a desk.

A Labor of Love

At its heart, A Rip In Time is the kind of RPG I've always wanted to play myself.

I've spent years bringing this world to life, and I hope that when the time comes, you'll have as much fun getting lost in it as I've had creating it.

data.short_description: A Rip In Time is a 2D pixel-art fantasy action RPG inspired by classic online adventures. Explore a sprawling world, master your class, discover powerful loot, and conquer dangerous dungeons. Forge your own path solo, team up in online co-op, or share the adventure in local split-screen.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Sistema Operativo: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processador: AMD Ryzen 3 3100 / Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memória: 8 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • Rede: Ligação à Internet de banda larga
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 5 GB de espaço livre
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recomendados:
  • Sistema Operativo: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processador: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i5-10400
  • Memória: 16 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD RX 570
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 5 GB de espaço livre
